Create a voxel space descriptor

Source: R/space.R
space_voxel.Rd

Create a voxel space descriptor

Alias for space_voxel

Usage

space_voxel(
  dim,
  affine,
  mask_bitmap = NULL,
  mask_idx = NULL,
  storage = c("dense", "packed"),
  template_id = NULL
)

space_voxels(
  dim,
  affine,
  mask_bitmap = NULL,
  mask_idx = NULL,
  storage = c("dense", "packed"),
  template_id = NULL
)

Arguments

dim

Integer vector of length 3 (x, y, z)

affine

4x4 affine matrix

mask_bitmap

Optional logical array matching dim

mask_idx

Optional integer vector of active voxel indices (mask order)

storage

Either "dense" or "packed"

template_id

Optional template identifier string

Value

An object of class c("space_voxel", "gds_space")
